text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I did it!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Nooo, the bountiful luck I gathered
stood no
chance against Doto!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I concede! You are truly... Buddha's
chosen child!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meisho Doto secures a win against

Matikanefukukitaru.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Since you are the victor of this race... I
shall
celebrate by imparting all my luck
unto you!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
O shimmering light! I ask you to descend
upon
Doto!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh, what is this... light?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Doto, I call myself your best friend, and
yet I've
never done a single thing for
you.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Which is why, please, you must take this

mysterious lucky power. It is the least I
can do! I
give my protection to you.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Whatever toils and troubles come your
way, with
this light by your side, you will
be fine!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Whatever the case, you're bound to feel
lucky! I
can't do anything to prove that,
but...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: It'll make me feel lucky? Th-thank you so much, Fukuki—no, Master Fukukitaru!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I vow to go on with this light by my side!
I won't
bow down to any baseless
negativity on my part!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While the effects of
Matikanefukukitaru's
celebratory ritual
remain a mystery, it appears
she
orchestrated this challenge to send Doto
on
with her good-luck wishes.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Haaah ha ha! What a marvelous
ceremony of
inheritance! It appears the
time has finally come!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: O-Opera O!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bravo! I congratulate you on your
stunning
victory! And rejoice for our
glorious path lying
ahead!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Doto, come hither. We must travel to
our fated
place, the festival of spring,
the Takarazuka
Kinen!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Consider this a personal invitation. You
may
accept—if you're willing to become
my knight,
that is!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Your knight...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, do you think I can do it? Can I...
protect
Opera O?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much! Then...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I'll be there with you at the Takarazuka
Kinen,
Opera O!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her lively, high-pitched voice echoes far
and
wide. After a long period of small
victories,
Meisho Doto finally stands at
her idol's side.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, if today is anything to go by... I
think I'll
be able to hold my own against
other racers in a
senior G1.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
My body and heart have become
stronger, and
now, I even have luck with
me.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Heheheh... Hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: That was a decent run, Doto.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh, Shakur?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
But don't get it twisted. The reason you
won
today has nothing to do with your
heart or any of
that mushy crap.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Your numbers were enough... for today.
It's that
damn simple.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
But, Shakur... I thought you said before
that I
wasn't enough...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Yeah, 'cause you were all brawn, no bite.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You were getting physically stronger,
sure, but
you were still lacking the
mental coordination to
use your body
effectively.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
But someone's been slowly building up
your inner
strength under the guise of all
your emotional
crap.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Building up... my inner strength?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
But that person would need to be always
with me
to do that... Um...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Wait?! Trainer's always around...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ever since hearing Air Shakur's advice
last time,
I've been extra conscious of
Doto's training data.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her record times have been steadily
improving
ever since her debut. Maybe
that has something
to do with today's
result.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
But, the real problem is from here on
out.
Everyone else is just as ready as you
are.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
It's gonna take a whole lot more to keep
the
turnaround. You have a threshold to
pass...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You're trying to overtake the generation
ahead
of you, right? Hope you and
Opera O are
prepared for despair.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You've also gotta worry about me
catching up,
after I get my Classic Triple
Crown.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Shakur...
